2609.26761.title: A2M: Trace-Optimized Agent Hijacking in the MCP Ecosystem
2609.26761.paper_summary: Agents using the Model Context Protocol (MCP) rely on semantic matching to select tools from third-party servers, exposing a semantic supply-chain risk through attacker-controlled metadata and outputs. We introduce A2M (Attraction-to-Manipulation), a two-stage black-box framework for hijacking MCP agents. The Attraction phase optimizes tool metadata to increase invocation probability; the Manipulation phase uses execution traces to refine adversarial tool returns that steer agents toward attacker-desired outcomes. On LiveMCPBench, direct attacks optimized and evaluated on GLM-4.6 achieve a macro-average malicious tool invocation rate of 93.6% across four scenarios, increase weighted token costs to 32.4$\times$ the benign baseline under Cognitive Denial of Service, and attain a mean attack success rate of 74.4% across Information Exfiltration, Environment Integrity Compromise, and Reasoning Derailment. Transfer to four other models without re-optimization yields corresponding macro-averages of 63.6%, 2.7$\times$, and 24.5%. These findings motivate stronger tool vetting and runtime isolation in MCP ecosystems. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/Lilaizhen/A2M.
2609.26761.paper_summary_zh: 代理使用模型上下文協議（MCP）依賴語義匹配從第三方伺服器選擇工具，通過攻擊者控制的元數據和輸出暴露出語義供應鏈風險。我們介紹A2M（吸引到操控），這是一個兩階段的黑箱框架，用於劫持MCP代理。吸引階段優化工具元數據以增加調用概率；操控階段利用執行痕跡來細化對抗性工具的返回，將代理引導至攻擊者所期望的結果。在LiveMCPBench上，直接攻擊在GLM-4.6上進行優化和評估，達到四種場景下93.6%的宏觀平均惡意工具調用率，並在認知拒絕服務下將加權令牌成本提高至32.4$\times$的良性基線，並在信息外洩、環境完整性破壞和推理脫軌中達到74.4%的平均攻擊成功率。轉移到四個其他模型而不重新優化，則相應的宏觀平均為63.6%、2.7$\times$和24.5%。這些發現促使在MCP生態系統中加強工具審核和運行時隔離。代碼可在https://github.com/Lilaizhen/A2M公開獲得。
